sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the three levels of divine service: practical action, service through Ruach HaKodesh, and service through Goral, which includes faith and self-nullification beyond intellect.

translations.translation: And now, similarly, this is also the case regarding the entirety of the matter of divine service,
which has three modes71
: the service related to turning away from evil and doing good in actual deed,
where action is the main thing,
and likewise “to the many you shall increase [its inheritance] and to the few you shall decrease [its inheritance],”
for each person’s service is according to the manner of his portion in the world that was given to him, which he must affect through the two lines of turning away from evil and doing good.
On a higher level is the service that is through Ruach HaKodesh,
and within this are included two matters.
And it is known that Ruach HaKodesh is the aspect of Malchus, which is the tenth Sefirah,
and sometimes it is explained
(in the discourse “Ushavtem”72
by the holy Rebbe
(the Rebbe Rashab)
of blessed memory),
that Ruach HaKodesh is the aspect of Chochmah,
from where they draw Ruach HaKodesh of the aspect of Malchus,
[and this is analogous to the known explanation of “Reishis,”
and “Bereishis” [contains] two [aspects of] “Reishis,”
that the two aspects of “Reishis”
(Chochmah and Malchus)
become one word],
for in this are included all ten Sefiros,
meaning that the matter of Ruach HaKodesh includes also the aspects and levels that are between Chochmah and Malchus within the soul.
And on a higher level is the service of Goral (lot),
and in this too there are two matters,
as explained by the holy Rebbe the Tzemach Tzedek73
[regarding] two explanations of the matter of Goral74,
one: faith,
two: self-nullification that is above intellect.
For these two modes are two extremes,
for the matter of faith is primarily in the Sefirah of Malchus, which is below and the end of all levels,
and the self-nullification that is above intellect and comprehension is from the aspect of the essence of the soul, which is above intellect,
for through this faith or this self-nullification, no doubt remains as to which path he is being led,
and it is clear that he is being led to all good,
and to the ultimate perfection of good,
and even to the point that he merits “your world you shall see in your life”75,
for there is revealed to him the aspect of “But the land shall be divided by lot,”
below ten handbreadths,
soul in body.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section connects the three modes of service to the future redemption, emphasizing that through the Rebbe's liberation and the power of mesirus nefesh, the final redemption will come with even greater glory.

translations.translation: And now, just as in the division of the Land of Israel at the first entry into the Land there were these three things
(“But the land shall be divided by lot,
according to the word of G-d through Ruach HaKodesh,
and to the many you shall increase and to the few you shall decrease”),
and through these three things they divided the land, in a manner that each one had his vine and his fig tree,
and the children of Israel were in rest and tranquility, each man under his vine and under his fig tree76,
so too will it be now through our deeds and our service,
and with even greater excellence and greater strength than it was then,
since there was a very great descent in the heels of Moshiach,
and especially the imprisonment and exile of the general souls of the leaders of Israel,
and even to the imprisonment and exile of the leader of Israel of our generation
(before 12-13 Tammuz),
now, through his redemption,
for not only him did the Holy One, blessed be He, redeem, but also all who love our holy Torah, those who observe the commandments, and even those who are called by the name of Israel77,
this redemption is a close preparation and a channel and vessel to draw down the general redemption of all the children of Israel wherever they are,
so that there will again be a conquest of the Land of Israel, in the manner of “And I will grant peace in the land… and I will lead you upright,”
through the three modes of service: Goral, Ruach HaKodesh, and “to the many you shall increase.”
And the main thing and foundation – through the decision with strength and with mesirus nefesh, as the Baal HaSimchah78 said,
that the matter of mesirus nefesh is the decision “thus and not otherwise,”
and when a Jew says
(when a Jew says)
that he decides thus,
it does not matter what his situation and standing was in the moment before,
and as the ruling of the Rambam79
that as soon as he says “I want,” his true will is revealed, that every Jew wants to fulfill the will of the Creator and to do all that depends on him so that the will of the Creator be fulfilled,

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section concludes that through this decision, the Creator's will to redeem every Jew from exile will be fulfilled, gathering them one by one with great love and bringing them upright to their land with the coming of Moshiach.

translations.translation: for through this, the will of the Creator is also fulfilled
(which is the essence of good and the nature of good to do good)
to take out each and every Jew from exile wherever he is,
and in the manner of “And you shall be gathered one by one, O children of Israel”80,
for this manner shows the greatness of endearment and the greatness of love and the greatness of individual Divine providence over each and every Jew81,
and He will lead us upright to our land82
very soon83
with the coming of Moshiach our righteousness.
